12月17日至18日，天津港保税区总工会2025年工会工作创新大赛圆满落幕。本次大赛聚焦**思想引领、维权服务、创新发展、幸福企业**四大赛道，经过四轮综合评审，结合现场精彩展示与工会日常工作成效的综合赋分，最终遴选出 15 家企业工会并授予 “灯塔工会” 称号。**云遥宇航工会凭借系统化实践与扎实创新成果，成功跻身其中，荣膺“灯塔工会”称号**。

![](/media/news/newsImg10_260407090638A078.webp)

自大赛启动以来，公司工会高度重视、精心部署，紧扣四大赛道核心要求，深挖工作亮点，系统提炼经验，全面展现新时代商业航天企业工会“围绕中心、服务大局、关爱职工”的使命担当。


### 思想引领：凝心聚力向深空

![](/media/news/ryjxImg4_260407090831A079.webp)

在航天强国的时代召唤下，云遥宇航构建政治领航筑牢思想根基、榜样领航点燃奋斗引擎 、 文化领航涵养团队生态、成长领航铺设成才通道的四维思想引领体系，推动理想信念融入日常、见于行动。“极致精度、无限探索、共享共担”是云遥人的工作哲学，更是逐梦深空的精神底色。依托院士工作站、重点实验室及职工创新工作室等高能级平台，公司持续强化技术攻关与人才培养，激发全员创新活力，一支有信仰、敢创新、能攻坚的航天铁军正加速成长。

### 维权服务：做最可信赖的“职工娘家人”

![](/media/news/ryjxImg1_260407090940A080.webp)

成立6年来，云遥宇航始终保持和谐稳定的劳动关系。这一成绩背后，是工会对“职工娘家人”职责的坚定践行。我们构建覆盖安全、薪酬、关爱与法治的全链条保障体系：定期开展工作场地安全检查，确保安心上岗；建立调薪机制，让员工共享发展成果；为应届毕业生提供一年免费公寓，助其轻装启程；主动安置残疾职工，量身匹配岗位；并通过普法宣传、法律咨询与诉求快速响应通道，推动维权从“事后处理”转向“源头预防”。正如员工所言：“在云遥，工作踏实，心也安稳。”

### 创新发展：以创新驱动逐梦苍穹

![](/media/news/ryjxImg2_260407091028A081.webp)

创新是航天事业的核心密码。从技术攻坚到卫星升空，从专利突破到产业赋能，每一颗“云遥卫星”的闪耀，都凝聚着一线职工的智慧与热爱。工会积极搭建创新平台，设立创新工作室、组织技能比武、推动成果转化，让“人人皆可创新、处处皆有舞台”成为现实。前路漫漫，星河璀璨，工会将持续赋能职工，在商业航天赛道上再创佳绩。

### 幸福企业：让幸福可感、可及、可持续

![](/media/news/ryjxImg3_260407091121A082.webp)

在云遥宇航，幸福是融入日常的点滴温暖。公司以“普惠+关爱”双轮驱动，精准回应员工需求：夜班餐补、心理测评、职工运动周、职称申报支持……件件小事汇聚成安心奋斗的底气。更令人激动的是，一线员工有机会亲临火箭发射现场，在轰鸣升空中见证自己参与创造的航天荣光——这不仅是激励，更是将个人奋斗融入国家梦想的情感纽带。**卫星上天，人心落地；唯有幸福的员工，才能成就伟大的事业**。

此次荣获“灯塔工会”称号，既是肯定，更是鞭策。未来，云遥宇航工会将继续以“服务大局、服务职工”为根本，擦亮工会品牌，为加快建设具有全球竞争力的商业航天企业凝聚磅礴力量，照亮更多追梦人的星辰征途！
Elected as "Lighthouse Union" | Yunyao Aerospace shines at Tianjin Port Free Trade Zone General Trade Union's 2025 Innovation Competition

From December 17th to 18th, the 2025 Work Innovation Competition of the Trade Union of Tianjin Port Free Trade Zone came to a successful conclusion. This competition focused on **Thought leadership, rights protection services, innovation and development, happy enterprise** Out of the four categories, after four rounds of comprehensive evaluations, combined with the comprehensive scoring based on the outstanding on-site presentations and the effectiveness of the trade union's daily work, 15 enterprise trade unions were ultimately selected and awarded the title of "Lighthouse Trade Union". **The Yunyao Aerospace Union, through systematic practice and solid innovative achievements, successfully made its way in and was honored with the title of "Lighthouse Union".**

![](/media/news/newsImg10_260407091358A083.webp)

Since the launch of the competition, the company's trade union has attached great importance to it and made meticulous arrangements. It has closely adhered to the core requirements of the four competition tracks, deeply explored the highlights of the work, systematically extracted experiences, and comprehensively demonstrated the mission and responsibility of the trade union of commercial aerospace enterprises in the new era - "centering on the main task, serving the overall situation, and caring for employees".


### Thought Leadership: Uniting Forces for Deep Space Exploration

![](/media/news/ryjxImg4_260407091502A084.webp)

Under the call of the era of space powerhouses, Yunyao Aerospace has established a four-dimensional ideological leadership system of political guidance to consolidate the ideological foundation, exemplary guidance to ignite the engine of struggle, cultural guidance to cultivate the team ecosystem, and growth guidance to lay the channels for talent development. This system promotes the integration of ideals and beliefs into daily life and is manifested in actions. "The pursuit of ultimate precision, unlimited exploration, sharing and mutual responsibility" is the work philosophy of Yunyao people, and it is also the spiritual background of pursuing dreams in the deep space. Relying on high-level platforms such as academician workstations, key laboratories, and staff innovation studios, the company continuously strengthens technological research and talent cultivation, stimulating the innovation vitality of all employees, and a space force with faith, the courage to innovate, and the ability to tackle challenges is accelerating its growth.

### Rights Protection Service: Becoming the Most Trustworthy "Welfare Organization for Workers"

![](/media/news/ryjxImg1_260407091610A085.webp)

Since its establishment six years ago, Yunyao Aerospace has maintained harmonious and stable labor relations. This achievement is attributed to the firm commitment of the trade union to its "workers' family" responsibilities. We have established a full-chain guarantee system covering safety, salary, care and law: conducting regular safety inspections of the work site to ensure a safe working environment; establishing a salary adjustment mechanism to enable employees to share the fruits of development; providing one-year free apartments for fresh graduates to help them start their journey with ease; actively arranging for disabled employees and matching them with suitable positions; and promoting rights protection from "post-event handling" to "prevention at the source" through legal education campaigns, legal consultations and rapid response channels for demands. As employees have said: "At Yunyao, the work is reliable and the heart is at ease."

### Innovation and Development: Dreaming of the Skies with Innovation-driven Approach

![](/media/news/ryjxImg2_260407091708A086.webp)

Innovation is the core secret of the aerospace industry. From technological breakthroughs to satellite launches, from patent breakthroughs to industrial empowerment, the brilliance of each "cloud remote sensing satellite" is the result of the wisdom and passion of the front-line workers. The trade union actively builds innovation platforms, sets up innovation studios, organizes skills competitions, and promotes the transformation of achievements, making "everyone can innovate and everywhere has a stage" a reality. The road ahead is long, but the stars shine brightly. The trade union will continue to empower workers and achieve even greater success in the commercial aerospace field.

### Happy Enterprise: Making Happiness Tangible, Accessible and Sustainable

![](/media/news/ryjxImg3_260407091818A087.webp)

At Yunyao Aerospace, happiness is found in the little comforts that permeate daily life. The company drives its operations with both "inclusive benefits" and "care" as its dual engines, precisely addressing the needs of its employees: night shift meal subsidies, psychological assessments, employee sports weeks, support for professional title applications... Each small matter contributes to the confidence to work with peace of mind. What's even more exciting is that frontline employees have the opportunity to visit the rocket launch site, witnessing the aerospace glory they have contributed to in the roar of takeoff - this is not only an inspiration, but also an emotional bond that integrates personal striving into the national dream. **When satellites go into orbit, hearts are grounded; only happy employees can achieve great undertakings.**

This recognition as the "Lighthouse Union" is both an affirmation and a motivation. In the future, the Yunyao Aerospace Union will continue to uphold the principle of "serving the overall situation and serving the workers", enhance the union brand, and pool powerful forces to accelerate the construction of a globally competitive commercial aerospace enterprise, illuminating the starry journey of more dream chasers!
